title: Effect of a Culturally-based Intervention on Sexual Risky Behavior Among Young American Indian Adolescents
brief_summary: Youth who participate in the Circle of Life (COL) program will report less sexual risk taking behavior compared to youth who do not receive the program.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 10-12 years old at baseline
* A member of participating Native Boys and Girls Club
* Signed Parental Consent Form
* Signed Parental Permission Form
* Signed Child Assent Form

Exclusion Criteria:

* None Noted
